label: RUCKUS WIPS
info:
Polls RUCKUS Unleashed for rogue APs and publishes state + commands over MQTT.

Edit credentials in the **fn_ruckus** function node (Setup tab → env vars) or set
RUCKUS_HOST / RUCKUS_USER / RUCKUS_PASS in the Node-RED add-on env.

Docs: see README.md and docs/MQTT_TOPICS.md in the repo.

name: Ruckus AJAX driver
